notAnIdeology.explanation: The term names a phenomenon, antisemites who express support for Zionism or Israel, for unrelated reasons (Christian end-times theology, white-nationalist admiration of an ethnostate, a wish to see Jews leave Europe, imperial interest). I went through the statements for positions its sources present as its own: the only shared content is support for a Jewish state (jewish-state-israel), and the expulsion and eschatology strands belong to other movements (white nationalism, Christian Zionism), so fewer than two statements are answerable from sources about this subject without a coatrack.

sources.title: The Old 'New Anti-Semitism' and Resurgent White Supremacy (Amy Kaplan, MERIP, 25 February 2018)
